providers_add.name: Maharajgunj Medical Campus (Institute of Medicine, TU)
providers_add.note: Established 1972 (2029 BS) as the first medical education centre of Nepal and the oldest constituent campus of the Institute of Medicine. Its official page lists 40+ graduate, postgraduate and super-specialty courses in medical, dental, laboratory technology, pharmacy, optometry, radiography, speech and language pathology and perfusion technology. Seats are counted under the Institute of Medicine entry. Phone 01-4514792.

providers_add.name: Maharajgunj Nursing Campus (Institute of Medicine, TU)
providers_add.note: Campus page lists B.Sc. Nursing, Bachelor of Nursing Science (Adult, Child, Community and Psychiatric tracks) and the Master of Nursing (Psychiatric, Adult, Pediatric, Women Health Development). The campus text says the MN began in 2051 BS, B.Sc. Nursing in 2062 BS and PhD Nursing in 2068 BS. Phone 01-4720423.

providers_add.name: Gauradaha Agriculture Campus (IAAS, TU)
providers_add.note: The only constituent campus of the TU Institute of Agriculture and Animal Science in Koshi Province. Offers B.Sc.Ag. (4 years); its notice board (2026-10-01) announces local quota and IDF seat admission. Practice field of 5.5 bigha in front of the campus.

providers_add.name: Rampur Campus (IAAS, TU)
providers_add.note: The first agriculture college of TU, started in 1972 at Pulchowk and moved to Rampur, Chitwan in 1974 (campus land 235 ha). Offers B.Sc.Ag. Official page: Institute of Agriculture and Animal Science.

providers_add.name: Public Youth Campus (TU)
providers_add.note: TU Faculty of Management constituent campus, established 1971 (2028 BS) after the New Education System Plan. Courses on its page: BBA, BBM, MBS and MBM. Phone 9851326760.

providers_add.name: Bishwa Bhasa Campus (TU)
providers_add.note: TU foreign language campus. Its notices (2026) publish results of German, Italian, Japanese and Spanish language levels (II to VI) and a level test, and it has a section for foreign students. Course fees are not on the page.
